# Acme

> Acme is a command-line tool for syncing project metadata between a
> repository and its issue tracker.

Every page linked below is Markdown, written for agents to read directly.

## Docs

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install Acme and run a first sync
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md#the-config-file): every key in `acme.toml`

## Optional

- [Changelog](docs/changelog.md)
- [API reference](https://api.acme.dev/reference#endpoints): the HTTP API, generated from the server
